entries.org: Data Science East Africa, Nairobi, Kenya
entries.summary: Supported ETL workflows and data-pipeline development across inventory and logistics source systems. Collaborated cross-functionally to optimize pipelines, lifting operational efficiency by 15%. Performed data validation and implemented governance and access controls, raising data integrity by 20% and supporting secure, reliable analytics pipelines. Used Grafana and Tableau for dashboarding and real-time analysis of streaming pipelines, supporting platform observability and monitoring.

Architected and maintained scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting and standardizing transaction data from 50,000+ merchant partners and 1M+ active customers across four countries, processing $100M+ in annual credit volume while reducing pipeline latency by 40% to enable near-real-time decisioning. Designed and deployed a centralized data warehouse consolidating the core banking system, payment gateways and merchant APIs, reducing daily portfolio risk report generation from 6 hours to 45 minutes. Built and optimized the data infrastructure and feature pipelines powering a proprietary credit-scoring and ML system, reducing approval turnaround from 48 hours to under 5 seconds. Developed real-time fraud detection pipelines monitoring behavioral metrics and transaction velocity, flagging 2,000+ suspicious transactions daily and improving detection accuracy by 30% with no impact to checkout. Engineered secure data integrations with open finance partners (Mono, Pngme) to enrich customer profiles, increasing approval rates by 25% for previously unbanked customers.

Architected and maintained high-volume ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, Airflow, dbt) ingesting and standardizing financial transactions from 20,000+ SMBs across 50+ financial institutions, scaling to 30M monthly transactions while reducing end-to-end pipeline latency by 35%. Developed automated data-quality monitors and reconciliation protocols detecting 1,200+ daily data anomalies, improving bookkeeping accuracy by 25% and saving the operations team about 20 hours per week. Designed and deployed a centralized cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery) consolidating 15 disparate source systems, reducing monthly financial report generation from 3 days to 2 hours. Implemented a semantic data layer and curated data marts enabling 50+ non-technical stakeholders to self-serve queries, cutting ad-hoc engineering requests by 60%. Engineered secure, high-performance data export APIs and migration pipelines, cutting full client data migration time from 5 days to under 4 hours while ensuring SOC2 and financial audit compliance.

Developed modular Python and Bash/Shell scripts to extract, transform and load time-series telemetry and quality-testing datasets from manufacturing IoT sensors and testing equipment, reducing manual data-preparation time by 40%. Automated validation checks and standardized data-recording structures, boosting dataset reliability and completeness by 25% across factory and field data collection. Engineered analytics-ready performance datasets across 50+ product models, applying statistical modeling and hypothesis testing (Python/R) to guide manufacturing decisions.
